4222-4348-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4348-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
4222-4348-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat from step 1

78-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
78-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Steel Leaf Paladin by paying its mana cost.
When Steel Leaf Paladin enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-5686-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5686-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

628-7218-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

765-5686-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7768.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-6289.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2842-3967-4681-5170.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2173-2685-5078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2173-2685-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2403.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-2403.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

277-1669-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-1669-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1580-5231-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {R}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat

2921-3139--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2099-2558-5687-5688.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

914-4125-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4125-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Dockside Extortionist and Shipwreck Dowser enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-4125-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1494-4452-5974.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Numa triggers, causing you to pay {10} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1283-1786-4067-5898.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Intimidation Campaign by paying {3}.
When Intimidation Campaign enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life, and you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Queza triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Intimidation Campaign's second ability triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
If you have less than {3} available, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
If Chromatic Orrery is untapped, activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1309-1987-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Palinchron.
When Salvager of Secrets and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

1561-5042.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
Your deck size is even.
1561-5042.description: Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to lose half your life total rounded up and draw your library due to Teferi's Ageless Insight.

1530-1927-2334-3544.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-1927-2334-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1651-3302-4682.notablePrerequisites:
Otherworld Atlas has at least one charge counter on it.
At least two of your opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1651-3302-4682.description:
Activate Otherworld Atlas by tapping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Otherworld Atlas.
Repeat.

4112-4375-5256.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

944-3498-3613-4050.description:
Cast Baithook Angler from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Hook-Haunt Drifter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hook-Haunt Drifter, adding {U}.
Because Dress Down causes Hook-Haunt Drifter to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Baithook Angler.
Repeat.

1167-2047-3604.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Mindslaver.
Activate the token Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2034-3847-5224.notablePrerequisites: Arcbound Worker has at least one counter on it.
2034-3847-5224.description:
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Arcbound Worker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Acrbound Worker, adding {C}{C}.
Arcbound Worker dies, triggering its modular ability and Together Forever.
Resolve the Arcbound Worker trigger, moving its +1/+1 counters onto another artifact creature.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Arcbound Worker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Arcbound Worker by paying {1}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2773-3356.description:
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
When Polyraptor enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 5 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor dies as a state-based action due to lethal damage.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2 using the new Polyraptor token instead.

1651-1737-2637-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles.
1651-1737-2637-4659-4840.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mechtitan Core.
Activate the Mechtitan Core token by paying {5} and exiling it, Myr Battlesphere, and any three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles, creating a 10/10 Mechtitan creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Mechtitan token, adding {C}{C}.
The Mechtitan core token triggers, returning all other cards exiled by it to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myr tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2281-4050-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding one mana of any color.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
